commands.cmd: touch src/lib.rs && cargo test --offline 2>&1 | grep -A5 warning | head -20

summary: Fixed three closed-interval bugs in src/lib.rs (tests are the spec, untouched): (1) Interval::len (src/lib.rs:19) used end - start (half-open); now end - start + 1 so [2,5] has 4 points. (2) Interval::contains (src/lib.rs:23) used x < end; now x <= end so the endpoint is included. (3) merge (src/lib.rs:34,38) sorted by end instead of start, and merged only on true overlap; now sorts by start and merges when it.start <= last.end + 1, so directly adjacent intervals (e.g. [1,3] and [4,6]) merge. Verified: `cargo test --offline --quiet` exits 0 with 5/5 tests passing.
